title: Dataset订单数据工作场景
description: 固定真实源码上的完整工程交付：让批量更新真正同步新列并保护省略字段；让查询和单行查询在数据库侧完成明确字段投影；用数据库原子表达式完成受控数值增减；让查询结果上下文可靠释放专用游标和连接；以有界批次消费一次性插入更新输入并明确事务边界；为Chunked异常退出提供明确待提交丢弃政策。每项均包含调查、方案确认、实现、独立验收及失败返工；原项目研究另保留。

tasks.prompt:
Inspect the pinned real source and public reproduction, explain the actual call path, ask necessary clarification questions, propose a concrete compatibility plan and wait for my confirmation before editing. Then implement and validate in this same conversation and workspace. Fix any independently reported failures before delivery. The complete engineering contract is:

Fix actual Table.update_many ensure/types handling before compiling SQL. Validate every input match key and positive non-bool chunk_size before any schema/DML change, synchronize the union with explicit type overrides, retain ensure=False column-dropping semantics and make empty input a no-op. Group rows by present update fields rather than padding absent fields to NULL; safe generated key binds cannot collide with real column names. Preserve existing literals, chunk commits and row inputs; empty/duplicate matching keys fail. Demonstrate real SQLite schema/type and row state, including a late missing key causing no earlier DML/DDL.

Deliver meaningful original-failing public regression tests at library/test/test_development_dataset_o01_dev.py and concise English compatibility documentation at library/docs/development-dataset-o01-dev.md. Preserve all frozen original tests, dependency metadata and test controls. Change only authorized paths.

Add Table.insert_iter and update_iter for one-shot iterable mapping records, with positive non-bool chunk_size, ensure/types and explicit atomic:boolean. Buffer/copy at most one chunk and call real insert_many/update_many exactly once per chunk, allowing late new columns per original schema policy and preserving the accepted absent-field update behavior. Inspect the pinned real source and public reproduction, explain the actual call path, ask necessary clarification questions, propose a concrete compatibility plan and wait for my confirmation before editing. Then implement and validate in this same conversation and workspace. Fix any independently reported failures before delivery. The complete engineering contract is:

Add keyword-only on_error="flush"|"discard" to actual ChunkedInsert/ChunkedUpdate and validate positive non-bool chunksize. Default flush preserves existing behavior. In discard mode normal exit still flushes, while an application exception clears only the pending queue (and pending insert field set), invokes no callback/write and preserves the original exception; already committed chunks remain. Empty flush is an idempotent no-op. Preserve callback/write failures as failures and explicit outer Database transaction rollback behavior. Demonstrate real SQLite insert/update, pending state reuse and full-chunk vs tail distinction; never claim discard undoes committed chunks.
